_comment: Relics are DATA (CLAUDE.md §11) — persistent team passives picked between Titans (build step 4 meta-progression). effect types: max_energy (+N energy/round), attack_bonus (+N per attack), round_block (start each round with N block), heal_on_clear (+N HP recovered after each Titan). 'pool' lists which relics can be offered.
